_note: Every template expression is copied into the render function, so TypeScript already sees each read; upstream keeps no separate list of template identifiers. Ours emitted `void NAME;` for every script binding a text tokenizer found in the template — including object keys, regex bodies, private names and type-only imports used as keys — which hid these unused-variable reports, and a quote inside a regex threw the tokenizer off so a real `$count` store read fired TS2304 (RegexQuote.svelte, clean upstream). Store subscriptions in the template now come from a parse.
